## Summary

- limit `Test Scripts` pull request triggers to `.agent` and Sepo-owned `.github` paths
- run the check by default only in `self-evolving/repo`, with `AGENT_TEST_SCRIPTS_ENABLED=true` as a downstream opt-in
- document and regression-test the workflow contract

## Testing

- `npm --prefix .agent run test:ci`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #460

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: 40bca3678b8e3acdb1a92a4dbfaf750347b16dd7 -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #463 limits automatic Test Scripts runs to Sepo-owned paths and enables them by default only in `self-evolving/repo`. Downstream repositories can opt in with `AGENT_TEST_SCRIPTS_ENABLED=true`, while manual dispatch remains available. The implementation matches the final design requested in #460 and includes documentation and contract coverage. One path-filter coverage gap remains.

## Review

The authorization, gating, and manual-dispatch behavior are sound, and CI passes. However, the new path allowlist omits files already validated by the test suite.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Issue-template changes bypass Test Scripts | WARNING | [`check:workflow`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/40bca3678b8e3acdb1a92a4dbfaf750347b16dd7/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts#L1610-L1673) validates two issue templates, but the [new path filter](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/40bca3678b8e3acdb1a92a4dbfaf750347b16dd7/.github/workflows/test-scripts.yml#L5-L9) omits `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**`. A PR changing only those templates will skip their existing contract tests. |

## Progress

- The source-repository default, downstream opt-in, and manual-dispatch escape hatch match #460’s requested design.
- Test Scripts passes at the reviewed head, and independent `test:ci` and `git diff --check` validation passed.
- Rubric review passed with no authorization, runtime, or workflow-gate violations.
- The required-check caveat was already acknowledged in #460 and is not active under the current ruleset.
- Posted one deduplicated [inline comment](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/463#discussion_r3562732191); no prior inline comments or threads required cleanup.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Issue-template changes bypass Test Scripts</summary>

**Cause:** The static `pull_request.paths` list does not include `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**`, although `envelope.test.ts` reads and asserts `install-sepo.md` and `ask-sepo.md`.

**Candidate solutions:**

- Add `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**` to the workflow filter.
- Update the exact path-array assertion and supported-workflows documentation to match.

**Comments:** One reviewer considered the allowlist complete and recommended shipping; another identified the omission. Inspection of the current head confirms the templates are actively validated, so the warning remains supported.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR`: Add the missing issue-template path and synchronize the contract test and documentation; this is a small, safe automated branch change.

## Final Verdict

`MINOR_ISSUES`

## Action Items

- [ ] Add `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**` to the Test Scripts path filter and update the asserted and documented path lists.
